## Description
A brief description of what this pull request changes, improves, or adds.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds new pipeline or visual capability)
- [ ] 🎨 Asset addition (CC0 / CC-BY music, SFX, or gameplay clip)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement (render speed, memory footprint)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the zero-bundler, pure ES module architecture.
- [ ] Tested locally on Google Chrome (or Chromium-based browser).
- [ ] No Node.js-only dependencies added to browser runtime.
- [ ] If submitting media: license is verified as CC0 or CC-BY with proof URL.
- [ ] Verified that memory usage remains stable during long exports.
